subject: EosHealth launch — transfer to CS, kickoff options & runbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@eoshealth.com>, ProcureOps <procure@eoshealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: EosHealth launch — transfer to CS, kickoff options & runbook

Hi Olivia (and ProcureOps),

Great to confirm — glad to have EosHealth onboard. Contract is executed (attached signed SOW) and procurement items are complete from our side. I’m looping in our Customer Success and Implementation leads so we can transition ownership and get a kickoff on the calendar.

Key context for CS:
- Deal: Pilot -> Production rollout for clinical summarization (model inference via Redwood Dedicated).
- Committed start: target UAT week of Sep 20; go-live target Oct 18.
- Initial throughput expectation: ~300 qps peak, median seq length ~512 tokens.
- Data handling: PII will be redacted before sending to us; customer requests US-East hosting and audit logs retained 180 days.
- Commercials: 12-month committed reserved capacity, see signed-SOW-eoshealth-20260903.pdf (attached).

Known risks / open items for CS to own:
1) Network access: Eos needs us to confirm egress IPs and provide a short security questionnaire (they asked for an attestation and network allowlist).
2) Staging creds: they will provide a staging AWS role for us to deploy a private agent — need request details.
3) Eval criteria: success metrics include 95th percentile latency < 180ms and token accuracy baseline (eval set will be shared).

Attachments included: signed-SOW-eoshealth-20260903.pdf, initial-runbook stub. I also uploaded a more detailed runbook to the shared Drive link below.

Next steps (proposed):
- Marissa: take Implementation Lead on intake and schedule a 60-minute kickoff the week of Sep 20.
- Connor: SRE/ops point for network & infra alignment.
- Karthik: CS escalation/backstop for adoption metrics.

Olivia — are you available Wed Sep 15 at 10am PT or Mon Sep 20 at 11am PT for a launch kickoff? If neither works, propose a time and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0142 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com

Attachments: signed-SOW-eoshealth-20260903.pdf, initial-runbook-stub.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EosHealth launch — transfer to CS, kickoff options & runbook

Thanks Tessa — quick internal note before we reply to Eos:

I can cover the SOC2/security Q&A initially, but Marissa should be primary for the implementation plan and day-to-day onboarding. A few items to confirm so we have a clean handoff:
- Confirm which model variant we're serving (redwood-llama-13b-quant vs rwd-llama-13b-8bit) — affects GPU footprint and latency commitments. Tessa: do we have a technical preference noted in the SOW?
- Please ask Eos for the staging IAM role ARN and a point of contact for their networking team (we'll need to supply egress IPs and a CIDR for allowlisting).
- We should validate their redaction workflow (POC: redaction service before tokenization) — if they can't redact on their side, we need to scope a proxy.

I attached a short security summary we normally send customers — network-security-summary-eos.docx. Marissa, if you accept the lead, I'll hand off the security threads and jump in if there's any escalation.

-Karthik
Sr. Customer Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
(karthik.iyer@redwood.com)

Attachment: network-security-summary-eos.docx

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@eoshealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@eoshealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EosHealth launch — transfer to CS, kickoff options & runbook

Thanks Tessa — excited to kick this off. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Hosting: yes, US-East is required for our compliance team.
- Staging: we’ll provide an IAM role (we aim to share the ARN by EOD Fri Sep 10).
- Kickoff: Sep 20 at 11am PT works for our engineering and product leads. Please send a calendar invite.
- Security: our security reviewer (procure@eoshealth.com) asked whether Redwood will sign a short addendum on data retention and logging. I attached their procurement reference in a separate email thread (cc’d).

On the model variant: we prefer the latency-focused instance if you can meet the 95th percentile SLA. If there’s a tradeoff we should discuss in the kickoff.

I’ll wait for Marissa’s implementation plan and the kickoff invite.

—Olivia
Head of Product | EosHealth
olivia@eoshealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@eoshealth.com>, ProcureOps <procure@eoshealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EosHealth launch — transfer to CS, kickoff options & runbook

Hi Olivia (and team),

Thanks — I’ll take lead on Implementation and own the kickoff coordination. I’ve attached the implementation runbook (Eos_Implementation_Runbook_v1.2.pdf) — it contains the first-60-day timeline, owners, and dependencies. High-level plan below:

Week 0 (pre-kickoff):
- Receive staging IAM role + allowlist info (Eos) — action: Eos
- Confirm model variant and capacity profile (Tessa + Infrastructure) — action: Tessa/Connor
- Share onboarding playbook and invite list — action: Marissa

Kickoff (60m) — Sep 20, 11:00am PT
- Attendees: Eos engineering, Eos product, Marissa (Implementation Lead), Connor (SRE), Karthik (Reliability)
- Agenda: goals & success metrics, infra & networking, data flow & redaction, test plan + eval set, timeline & handoff to post-sale CS.

Week 1–4 (UAT + tuning):
- Deploy to staging, run smoke tests, iterate on prompt/eval thresholds.
- Monitoring hooks and tracer setup for token-level cost analysis.

Key asks from Eos before kickoff:
1) Staging IAM role ARN and a network contact + allowlist window.
2) Confirmation on retention window (you requested 180 days) and whether audit logs must be forwarded to your SIEM.

I added the kickoff invite to the shared calendar link (https://cal.redwood.example/kickoffs/EOS-Sep20) and uploaded the runbook to the drive folder in the related links. Connor — can you prepare the egress IP list and a short note on model-variant tradeoffs by Friday? Karthik — I’ll loop you in on any security Qs.

Olivia — if Sep 20 at 11am PT still works I’ll send a final calendar invite with dial-in and pre-kickoff checklist.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (617) 555-0298

Attachments: Eos_Implementation_Runbook_v1.2.pdf
